name: Early
description:
Employee arrived before the official reporting window.
Can be used to reward consistency or for overtime calculations (if applicable).

name: On Time
description: Employee arrived within the acceptable reporting window.

name: Late
description:
Employee exceeded the grace period and is marked late.
Flag for monthly lateness report.
Notify supervisor automatically.

name: Very Late
description:
Employee arrived excessively late.
Recommended: Salary deduction + Auto-trigger HR warning after 3 occurrences.
Highlight in red on dashboard.

name: Absent
description:
No clock-in by 9:00 AM or later. Auto-flag as ABSENT.
Suspend system login access and require staff to report to HR unless approved leave exists.
